summary: Package an app by embedding podman-compose.yaml in a FROM scratch image with LABEL appType="compose", then build and push it to your OCI registry with podman; the device OS must include podman-compose.
questions: How do I build an application package image for Edge Manager?
What label marks a compose application image?
Does the device need podman-compose installed?

answer_card.title: Build an Edge Manager app package
answer_card.answer_md:
```dockerfile
FROM scratch
COPY podman-compose.yaml /podman-compose.yaml
LABEL appType="compose"
```
```bash
OCI_IMAGE_REPO=quay.io/<org>/<image>
OCI_IMAGE_TAG=v1
podman build -t ${OCI_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG} .
podman push ${OCI_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG}
```
